data.name: Miskiyyah
data.gender_notes: Miskiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'misk' meaning honey or sweet. This name evokes the idea of something delightful and precious. In the spiritual context of Islam, it may symbolize the sweetness of faith, the sweetness of the Prophet's companions, or the sweetness of spiritual knowledge. The name Miskiyyah carries the meaning “Sweet, Delicious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Miskiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet, delicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the sweetness of faith and spiritual knowledge in Islam.
data.etymology: Miskiyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet, Delicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miskiyyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
